# 🚫 NoSpaceInName **Simple Name Sanitizer for Allay** ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0-green.svg) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Allay-orange.svg)
[![Русский](https://img.shields.io/badge/Язык-Русский-red?style=for-the-badge&logo=google-translate&logoColor=white)](README_RU.md)
--- **NoSpaceInName** is a lightweight utility plugin designed for **Allay** servers. It automatically detects spaces in player names upon login and replaces them with a configured character (default: `_`). This ensures compatibility with plugins and systems that do not support spaces in usernames. ### ✨ Features - **Automatic Sanitization**: Instantly replaces spaces in usernames during the login process. - **Configurable Replacement**: Choose any character to replace spaces (e.g., `_`, `-`, or nothing). - **UUID Preservation**: Maintains the original UUID of the player to prevent data loss. - **Performance**: Extremely lightweight with zero impact on server performance. ### ⚙️ Configuration The configuration is simple and located in `config.yml`: ```yaml # The character to replace spaces with. # Default: "_" replaceWith: "_" ``` ### 🛠️ Usage 1. **Install**: Drop the `NoSpaceInName.jar` into your `plugins` folder. 2. **Restart**: Restart your Allay server. 3. **Done!**: Any player joining with a space in their name (e.g., "Steve Jobs") will be renamed (e.g., "Steve_Jobs"). ---

Created by Miroshka specifically for Allay with ❤️
